behavior: Passed mixed encodings, uppercase hex, repeated checksum, original request order, active/trashed duplicates, empty request, owner/checksum repository arguments, and differential output checks for every workload.

method.timing: Batch mean per invocation; medians across batches. Assertions and fixture generation excluded.
method.limitations: CPU microbenchmark only. Repository returns synthetic rows without SQL/network/I/O. No HTTP upload throughput, mobile connectivity, TLS, database, decoding, or whole-app speed claim. Warm process, shared host, no resource reservation or confidence interval. Candidate is the actual working-tree method compiled in isolation with upstream helper/enums; baseline is the actual stable image service method.
